title: 联想CFO温斯顿：PC成本压力持续，基础设施业务如何对冲？
speaker: Winston Chang

segments.en: Yeah. In terms of just the ongoing PC headwinds, I mean, when do you think we're going to see, I mean, a cap when it comes to memory prices and then like, I mean, do you see anything
segments.zh: 就PC市场持续的压力而言，您认为内存价格何时会见顶？您是否看到任何

segments.en: that could change the numbers in any way for you?
segments.zh: 可能以任何方式改变您的数字的因素？

segments.en: For the PC business? The PC business, I think the market had been anticipating now for greater than probably six months.
segments.zh: 对于PC业务？PC业务，我认为市场已经预期了大概超过六个月。

segments.en: Yeah. And so that's probably as end of last calendar year, I think this some of the industry reports had already anticipated with the greater memory and other component costs
segments.zh: 是的。所以大概在去年年底，一些行业报告已经预期到内存和其他组件成本上升

segments.en: that the volume will come down. And you're starting to see that come into fruition in the market as costs started coming into the channel.
segments.zh: 将导致销量下降。随着成本开始进入渠道，您开始看到这在市场中成为现实。

segments.en: And I think that will probably persist over the next two to three quarters from the device business perspective.
segments.zh: 从设备业务的角度来看，我认为这可能会持续两到三个季度。

segments.en: Yeah, from the device business perspective. For component costs. Yeah.
segments.zh: 是的，从设备业务的角度来看。对于组件成本。是的。

segments.en: We talk a little bit more about that. One of our favorite topics. Yeah, of course, of course.
segments.zh: 我们再谈一点。我们最喜欢的话题之一。是的，当然，当然。

segments.en: But I think we're getting benefits from both on the infrastructure side, of course, having the supply but with a strong demand.
segments.zh: 但我认为我们在基础设施方面都受益，当然，有供应也有强劲需求。

segments.en: The higher cost is really driven by the global compute on the infrastructure side of the business.
segments.zh: 更高的成本确实是由业务基础设施方面的全球计算需求驱动的。

segments.en: And we have one of the best business in that area.
segments.zh: 我们在该领域拥有最优质的业务之一。

segments.en: Right? Our ISG business, we become the number one X86 server provider this last quarter.
segments.zh: 对吧？我们的ISG业务在上季度成为X86服务器第一大供应商。

segments.en: So I think from that perspective, we are global footprint and our business growing in triple digits in terms of that revenue growth.
segments.zh: 因此从这个角度看，我们拥有全球布局，且该业务收入实现三位数增长。

segments.en: So I think a very strong demand in that side of the business.
segments.zh: 所以我认为该业务领域需求非常强劲。

segments.en: More than more offsets that decline in terms of volume.
segments.zh: 这很大程度上抵消了销量方面的下滑。
